documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30,2026.

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported standalone revenue from operations of INR247.03 crores and PAT of INR58.95 crores for Q1 FY27. Management projects top line revenue growth of 10% to 15% over the next 3 years, primarily driven by export markets. The company has ordered a new production line at its existing facility to add 5 lakh meters of capacity by February or March 2027. Sustainable operating margins are expected to be maintained around 25% plus 1% to 2%. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported Q4 FY26 standalone revenue from operations of INR 260.55 crores and PAT of INR 60.71 crores, driven by strong growth in exports.

guidance.claim: Management expects top line revenue growth between 10% to 15% for the next 3 years, with stronger growth in exports.
guidance.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market. But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

guidance.claim: The company expects its U.S. automotive business to grow by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

guidance.claim: Mayur Uniquoters expects domestic revenue growth between 8% and 10% and export growth between 15% and 20%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects export order momentum from the US to continue over the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: Management targets 15% revenue growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Export business growth is expected to outpace growth in domestic business.
guidance.quote: Our concentration towards our export business is much more and our growth in the export market will be higher than the growth in the domestic market.

guidance.claim: Profit margins are expected to remain at current levels or improve slightly.
guidance.quote: Definitely, it will remain in the similar levels where we are right now, and it can go slightly better also.

demand_outlook.claim: Standalone Q1 FY27 volume growth was around 2%, while the remaining growth came from product price mix.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth is driven by the volume is around 2% and remaining growth has come from price part.

demand_outlook.claim: Total export sales for Q1 FY27 reached INR103.80 crores, while total domestic sales were INR143.23 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Export general 30.24, export OEM 73.56, total exports is INR103.80 crores, auto OEM domestic 56.08, replacement, 36.52, footwear 41.16, furnishing 6.08 and other 3.38 and total domestic sale is 143.23.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic footwear segment experienced a degrowth in the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: That is not necessarily true, excepting domestic footwear market where we have had a degrowth in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Export sales volume grew by over 9%, compared to 1% growth in domestic volume.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume growth for domestic and export is in total. Export is 9% plus is the growth rate and 1% is domestic growth rate.

demand_outlook.claim: In FY26, the company achieved 35.5% growth in exports and over 4% growth in domestic business in value terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, we registered a total growth of 15% in value and out of that, around 35.5%, we achieved the growth in export and 4% plus we achieved in domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: Auto OEM export revenue grew from INR 194 crore in FY25 to INR 290 crore in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: Auto exports for the current year INR 290 Cr., and last year it was INR 194 Cr.

demand_outlook.claim: Full year sales for the PU business stood at around INR 27.08 crores.
The company's marine export business is growing fast and Europe presents a strong market for it.
demand_outlook.quote: So our Marine business is also growing very fast and Europe is also a great market for it.

demand_outlook.claim: The European automotive OEM industry is experiencing degrowth rather than growth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The new line will add an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capex for FY27 is around INR50 crores.
If an international facility expansion is finalized, total capex over the next 2 years could reach INR250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has planned a CAPEX of around INR 300 crore for a global expansion location.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The new coating line is scheduled to be operational by around the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating a plant in South India costing approximately INR 200 crores or a global plant costing INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So if we are evaluating which one we have to go for first. But if we do in South, it's approximately INR200 crores. If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant will take about two years from the decision date to start and will begin with an initial capacity of 500,000 meters per month.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start. And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capacity expansion under evaluation is for a PVC leather plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Whatever you're talking about expansion right now is about the PVC plant.

capex_expansion.claim: Mayur Uniquoters has formed a subsidiary company in Europe to export and warehouse products locally.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have now formed a new company in Europe, and we are exporting from India to Europe, getting stock over there and tackle customers over there also.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers a sustainable margin level to be around 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: The previous quarter's high margin was due to a one-time abnormal increase in foreign exchange rates.
margins_costs.quote: But last quarter, it was abnormally high because of foreign exchange increase in -- abnormally high increase in foreign exchange rates.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased partly due to export shipping freight costs increasing 4x during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account.

margins_costs.claim: For Q4 FY26, Mayur Uniquoters reported standalone revenue from operations of INR 260.55 crores and PAT of INR 60.71 crores.
margins_costs.quote: The company has achieved the revenue from operations on a standalone basis is INR 260.55 crores, PBT INR 82.59 crores, and PAT INR 60.71 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects long-term EBITDA margins to remain in the range of 25% to 30%.
margins_costs.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone Q3 FY26 revenue rose 22% YoY, while PBT and PAT increased by 71% and 77% YoY.
margins_costs.quote: In the quarter, the stand-alone revenue increased by 22% and PBT and PAT both increased by 71% and 77% on Y-o-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue increased by 14% YoY in Q3 FY26, with PBT up 58% and PAT up 66%.
margins_costs.quote: In this quarter, the consolidated revenue increased by 14% and PBT and PAT increased by 58% and 66%.

margins_costs.claim: Foreign exchange gains accounted for approximately 50% of Q3 FY26 other income.
margins_costs.quote: This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of plasticizers and yarn input raw materials have started increasing.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Current overall capacity utilization is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly PVC capacity stands between 3.5 million and 3.7 million meters depending on product mix.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The company received export supply orders from U.S. OEMs that are contributing to export revenue and profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Mayur Uniquoters expanded its business with Ford by securing additional platforms.
orders_capacity.quote: And our volume with Ford was very low. So, we have added more platforms on Ford business.

orders_capacity.claim: Export business currently represents around 42.5% of total revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: Export is around total 42.5% now and since we are focusing on export business more and especially automotive and export, therefore, it is expected to increase further.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone revenue for Q3 FY26 reached INR 236.99 crores with PBT at INR 70.08 crores and PAT at INR 52.93 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The company has achieved revenue from operations on a stand-alone basis is INR236.99 crores, PBT INR70.08 crores and PAT INR52.93 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sold in Q3 FY26 reached 76.3 lakh meters, which included 2.56 lakh meters of PU.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

capital_allocation.claim: The company recorded foreign exchange gains of around INR 30 crores in other income for the full year.
capital_allocation.quote: And our other income includes this foreign exchange gain of around INR 30 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management has not taken any final decision regarding a share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: So for buyback, we have not taken the call.

risks_headwinds.claim: Market volatility, tariffs, and regional wars have created uncertainty around selecting locations for international plants.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Footwear raw material costs including PVC and sole prices faced sharp increases and volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's PU plant faces underutilization and intense export competition from Chinese suppliers.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure.

risks_headwinds.claim: General export market shipments to the Middle East were temporarily impacted in Q4 due to war conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, what happened in the last quarter, because of the war situation, our general export market was temporarily impacted.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces market disruption from cheap imports coming from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China. There's a lot of manipulation.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets top line revenue growth between 10% to 15% for the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market. But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission its new 5-lakh meter production expansion line between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects U.S. automotive revenue to increase by 60% to 70% in the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased order momentum from US export supply to continue over the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management estimates CAPEX of around INR 300 crore for a global expansion facility.
management_commitments.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

management_commitments.claim: The coating line at the existing facility is expected to be completed by around the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased export momentum to continue over the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company has set a guidance target of 15% potential growth for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
